relationships.subject: second-eye femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery
relationships.evidence_quote: Ocular pain was significantly higher in patients who underwent second-eye FLACS.

relationships.subject: second-eye femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery
relationships.evidence_quote: MCP-1 levels were significantly higher in patients who underwent second-eye FLACS

relationships.subject: MCP-1
relationships.evidence_quote: VAS scores were positively correlated with MCP-1 levels across all patients

key_findings: Second-eye FLACS caused more pain and higher aqueous MCP-1, with VAS positively correlated with MCP-1.
PGE2, IL-6, IL-8 and miosis did not differ between first- and second-eye surgery.
